question.text:
Statement I Band gap in germanium is small.
Statement II The energy spread of each germanium atomic energy level is infinitesimally small.

options.text: Statement I is true, Statement II is true, Statement II is a correct explanation for Statement I
Statement I is true, Statement II is true, Statement II is not a correct explanation for Statement I
Statement-I is true, Statement II is false
Statement-I is talse, Statement II is true

solution.text:
Germanium, semi-conductor substance, has small band gap in comparison to insulator (non-metal).
On moving top to bottom in the group 14 band gap decreases.
